Do not file public vulnerability reports here.

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting from the repository's **Security**
tab. Open **Advisories**, then choose **Report a vulnerability** and follow
[`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md). Do not include seed words, passphrases,
private keys, real descriptors, wallet backup files, signer locations, or
personal wallet metadata in public issues.
